name: mibi-adult-S03-b
refs: The adult of this species (project-owned rig render): its body plan, proportions and colours only, a crude 3D blockout to be painted over: a long low four-legged animal with a pale body, a teal head and a long thin tail.
The species' signed silhouette (project-owned): the adult's outline.
prompt: Paint the ADULT of the creature in the references: a slender four-legged animal with a pale mint-white body and legs, a soft teal head with round teal ears, and a thin tail. Keep its body plan, proportions and colours, but NOT the blockout's geometry. It has a FACE: two large round teal eyes with a pale highlight, a small calm mouth, and a single short thin antenna on top of the head. This is the species' BARE BASE picture: a plain pale mint-white coat with NO spots, NO patches and NO stripes (the teal only on the head and ears); a SHORT thin tail ending in a small round pale gold bulb that is UNLIT (no glow, no light). Soft, rounded, living forms; slim legs with small rounded paws, never slabs or blocks. Matte painterly rendering like a children's book, smooth painted forms, gentle shading, light from the top left, a soft flat contact shadow beneath it. Three-quarter view from the front left, facing the viewer, calm, standing at rest on all four legs. One creature, centred, large, on a plain flat solid magenta (#FF00FF) background with nothing else. No outline glow, no text, no ground, no props, no people.
